name: Ophelia
source: Ophelia is the mistress of King Lucius. Due to the situation surrounding Queen Effie's death, Atlas does not hold her with high regard. The same can be said for most of the court, although this never seems to bother her. Those that have seen her dance have called it "enthralling".
